label: 3D turntable – drag the tonearm onto the record to play, back to its rest to stop, or use the controls on the deck
glassLabel: Glass record player – drag the tonearm onto the record or tap the record or the middle button to play/pause, the side buttons skip; drag along the progress bar to seek
